# HHLManyBody22.ClockReuse

**clock寄存器真实复用**

刻画实际已归零/可reset控制扇区的寄存器复用与污染误差，而不把固定到1等同|0>。

**边界**：PDF pp15–16. Reuse requires actual disentanglement/reset and sufficient zero-fixed bits. Counting a classical fixing label alone is insufficient.

**覆盖等级**：D
